schema.description: A module is usually one repository. It can also be a path in a repository, or one service. A module has one owner only, and that owner is a team or a product. The lists of links name the other teams and the other products that use the module. A link gives no authority over the module.

key.description: A short name, for example "server". Unique in the workspace.

verification.description: How an agent run checks its work in this module. Null means that the module gives no checks to a run.

allOf.description: The commands that an agent run uses to prepare and check its work in a module. The server keeps the object that you send. When a run reads it, the run ignores a field that has the wrong type. If an issue names more than one module, the run merges their values. If two modules give different values for one command, the run gets no value for that command. The run gets all the setup commands and all the egress hosts of the modules.

setupCommands.description: The commands that prepare the work, for example `pnpm install`. The run executes them one time, with network access.

egressHosts.description: The host names that the setup commands can connect to in a hosted sandbox, in addition to the model provider and the npm registry. For example, a Go module names `proxy.golang.org`. The run ignores a value that is not a host name.

testCommand.description: The command that runs the tests.

lintCommand.description: The command that runs the linter.

typecheckCommand.description: The command that checks the types.

buildCommand.description: The command that builds the code.

allOf.title: ModuleVerification

schema.title: Module

401.description: The request has no valid token or session.
